title: Canonical inclusion of finite-subextension-valued algebraic closure coefficients
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and the normed algebraic closure used by the finite-subextension-valued condensed ring $C$ [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed]. Let $B$ be all continuous functions with that topology [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring]. Define algClTopologyInclusionRing by the actual sectionwise subtype inclusion $C(P)\hookrightarrow B(P)$, with the existing universe lifts. Define algClTopologyInclusion by forgetting to the underlying abelian sheaf ring objects. No equivalence or flatness is asserted.
